Project Milestones The primary deliverable in the project is a report, consisting of the 3 volumes noted above. To verify that the report satisfies the goals of the project, a set of 10 milestones was developed. Of the 10 milestones, 8 were associated with the completion of the 8 principal technical tasks. The ninth milestone was an independent review of the draft reports, and the tenth milestone was the submittal of the final report to the OTSI website. A list of the milestones is presented in Table 6-1. As defined in the Statement of Project Objectives, the independent review group was to consist of 1 project developer, 1 EPC contractor, and 2 other participants in the CSP industry, including project developers, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, and users of nitrate salt technology. The final makeup of the review group included the following organizations: • Project developer: Vast Energy • EPC contractors and consultants: Fichtner; Alia Energy; and High Temperature System Designs • Equipment vendor: Contratos y Diseňos Industriales • Users of nitrate salt technology: Atlantica Yield; Cerro Dominador; and Crescent Dunes • National laboratories: National Renewable Energy Laboratory; and Sandia National Laboratories The reviews of the draft report were conducted under Task 9. The reviews were generally favorable, and included a range of comments and recommendations. The comments and recommendations were incorporated in a revised final report. The revised report was reviewed by DOE, and was judged to have satisfied the Statement of Project Objectives and the End of Project Requirements.
